name: IHSAA Cross Country Regionals
where: Indiana · New Prairie, Manchester, Brownsburg, Columbus (CERAland Sports Park) and Crawford County
headline: Indiana regionals: Seitz and Zieren meet at Crawford County
summary: Springs Valley's Calvin Seitz, last year's Indiana state champion and No. 10 in DyeStat's national rankings, races Evansville Reitz's Carter Zieren (No. 16) at the Crawford County regional, a week before the state finals at the LaVern Gibson course. At Nike XC Town Twilight, Seitz ran an Indiana-record 14:42.1 for third with Zieren fourth in 14:42.4. No. 21 Fort Wayne Carroll boys and No. 14 Homestead girls race at Manchester, No. 22 Carmel girls at Brownsburg, and Hamilton Southeastern's Anya Zoeller (No. 25) at CERAland. The Crawford County boys race starts at 11:15 a.m. ET.
